column1: # The cases of tests/export_search_strategy.rs (line RG, item F1): one run of LOSAT PROGRAM ARGS from LOSAT/,
# with -num_threads 1, 4 and 8 added, in a clean environment plus env (NAME=VALUE, comma-separated; - = none).
# args are split at spaces (%20 is a space inside an argument); {ss} is a file in the run's own folder.
# pre: text written to {ss} before the run (- = no file). check: ncbi = the strategy file ({ss} after the run,
# or its absence), standard output, standard error and exit status rc equal NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 -num_threads 1
# (fixtures/strategy/<name>.ss, .out, .err; an absent .out or .err is empty; the run folder's path in NCBI's
# messages is written as {ENGINE}); parser = LOSAT's argument parser refuses (rc 2, nothing on standard
# output) and the file is as NCBI left it (.ss); refuse = LOSAT refuses (rc, standard error contains expect).
